title: Laabam
desc: After returning to his hometown from exile, Pakkiri challenges Vanagamudi, the village chief. Soon, with the locals' support he tries to overhaul the village's farming techniques.

title: Vathiyaar
desc: Annadurai, an ordinary school teacher, turns into a Good Samaritan and runs an orphanage after a tragic incident. However, his actions are closely watched by ACP Easwara Pandian and his team.

title: Dhool
desc: Arumugam, a kind-hearted and honest man, finds himself involved in a fight against corrupt politicians after he protests against the pollution of water in his village.

title: Manam Kothi Paravai
desc: Kannan loves Revathy and, with the help of his friends, kidnaps her after her family arranges her marriage to someone else. However, he is shocked when she says that she does not love him.

title: Raangi
desc: Thaiyal Nayagi tries to protect her niece from an online predator. However, things escalate when the FBI's attempt to catch the culprit puts them both in danger as they unwittingly become bait.
